interface.title: hydro-reservoir-api (水库群调度 – 梯级水库发电调度优化计算), Swagger UI at /docs
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis: running a planning optimization on prepared input data and exporting the results
interface.what_it_is_for: Upload an Excel workbook describing two cascaded reservoirs (upstream 湖南镇水库 and downstream 黄坛口水库 in the sample), choose a daily, 10-day or monthly calculation step, run the joint hydropower scheduling optimization, and get the results back as an Excel workbook or as JSON.

data.note: I uploaded 输入.xlsx (433,976 bytes) to POST /api/compute. GET /api/sample returned the bundled demo file as sample_input.xlsx, with the same byte size. No browser page with charts or tables exists at '/'; the only interface is Swagger UI. Each compute run held up the single-worker server, so other requests (such as /openapi.json) timed out until it finished. Setup check, not a step of the science: GET /api/health returned {status: ok}, and GET /api/meta returned title 水库群调度, description 梯级水库发电调度优化计算, version 1.0.0 (screens/003.webp, screens/005.webp).

features.name: Upload a model input and run with a chosen time step
features.general: Attach an input data file, pick the time resolution of the simulation from a fixed set, pick the output format, run it, and get a clear error message for an invalid setting
features.specific: In the POST /api/compute form: choose the file (输入.xlsx), set calc_step to 日, 旬 or 月 (default 旬), set format to xlsx or json, and press Execute. Any other step value gets a 400 that names the allowed values. Only the 旬/xlsx run and the 年 rejection were confirmed; the 日 result is unconfirmed and no json response was ever displayed.
steps: Press Try it out on POST /api/compute
Leave format at xlsx (json is accepted, but its response was never displayed)
Press Execute and wait for the response (the spinner can outlast the server's answer)
Read the response code, or the 400 detail if the setting was invalid
serves_tasks: Supply the input file and the run settings
Run the optimization at the default 10-day step and download the result workbook
See how invalid run settings are rejected

features.name: Result workbook download with run metadata in headers
features.general: Download the computed results as a spreadsheet file that is labelled with the names of the modelled upstream and downstream units
features.specific: format=xlsx streams reservoir_result.xlsx (Content-Disposition attachment). X-Up-Res and X-Down-Res carry the URL-encoded upstream and downstream reservoir names (湖南镇水库 / 黄坛口水库), and Swagger shows a Download file link.

Any chart view of water level, flow or power output. The server has no page at '/'; the Swagger docs are the only interface, and Swagger cannot draw charts.
A preview of the upstream/downstream reservoir parameters before running. That preview only comes inside the json response, which I could not see.

Review the results (per-sheet result tables; water-level, flow and power time series as charts): no charting front end is served at '/', and the tables and chart series are only in the json response, which I could not display.
